# [STORY] As a maintainer, I want epic #22 and everything under it audited, so that "Cloud Deployment & Observability (Terraform, Kubernetes, Prometheus, ELK)" is accurate and test-backed

## User Story
**As a** maintainer
**I want** epic #22 and every story and task under it audited
**So that** "Cloud Deployment & Observability (Terraform, Kubernetes, Prometheus, ELK)" describes what was actually built, and every criterion is backed by a test or a re-runnable command

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given epic #22, when audited in epic mode, then it matches the epic template, meets the writing standard, and its native sub-issue links are complete and correct
- [x] Given story #87 and its 2 tasks, when its audit task below is done, then every one of them has been through the four gates (#259)
- [x] Given story #88 and its 3 tasks, when its audit task below is done, then every one of them has been through the four gates (#260)
- [x] Given story #89 and its 2 tasks, when its audit task below is done, then every one of them has been through the four gates (#261)
- [x] Given story #90 and its 3 tasks, when its audit task below is done, then every one of them has been through the four gates (#272)
- [x] Given every criterion and every issue's metadata in this subtree, when checked, then every criterion names a test, a CI step, or a re-runnable command with none closing on a date, and every issue carries one type label, one priority label, no `sprint-N` label, and a correct native parent link (manual: `infrastructure/scripts/audit-check.py 22 --tree` needs the `gh` CLI, unavailable in this session; checked by hand against #22, #87-#90, #23-#29, #70-#71, #112, #259-#261, #272)
- [x] Given every child story is audited, when epic #22 is checked, then it is closed if all its stories are closed, and left open otherwise (#22 closed 2026-08-01, all 4 child Stories closed)

- [x] Meets [Definition of Ready](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_READY.md)

## Notes
Scope: epic #22, its 4 stories, and the 10 tasks under them.

This Story's own diff is issue text, not code — #259, #260, #261 and #272 each wrote or fixed the tests their scope needed and met their own gates when they closed. The epic-mode audit of #22 found no shape or truth defects beyond wording (fixed) and a stale title on this Story itself (fixed: the original title was cut off mid-word).

`infrastructure/scripts/audit-check.py` shells out to the `gh` CLI, which this autonomous session's sandbox does not have. The mechanical checks it automates were done by hand instead, reading each issue's labels, milestone, parent link and criteria directly.
